text: DSH FTP Server 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 FTP 文件服务器插件，可从设置面板配置并启停服务。宿主端通过远程服务启动独立 Node.js FTP 进程，面板可查看运行状态、日志和共享根目录内容。用户可以设置监听地址、端口、共享目录、账号密码或匿名登录；FTP 客户端可浏览、上传、下载、重命名和删除文件。适合需要从 FTP 客户端访问 DSH 工作区指定目录的场景。连接使用明文 FTP，不支持 TLS。

DSH FTP Server provides a settings panel for starting and stopping a plain FTP server on the DSH host. Configure its address, port, shared directory, and login mode, then use an FTP client to browse or transfer files. The panel also shows service status, logs, and the shared directory listing.

DSH FTP Server 的功能「配置并启动 FTP 服务」：设置面板接受监听地址、端口、根目录、账号密码和匿名模式，并通过远程服务启动 FTP 子进程。
DSH FTP Server 的功能「查看状态与日志」：面板显示服务是否运行、进程信息、运行时长和近期日志，并可刷新状态。
DSH FTP Server 的功能「浏览共享根目录」：点击目录刷新后，面板调用宿主文件服务读取根目录条目并显示名称、类型和大小。
DSH FTP Server 的功能「通过 FTP 管理文件」：服务器支持目录列表、文件上传下载、追加、删除、创建目录及重命名等 FTP 操作。
DSH FTP Server 使用前须知：FTP 服务不支持 SSL/TLS，连接为明文传输。
我需要把 DSH 主机上的文件通过 FTP 提供给局域网客户端。
I want to upload and download files in a directory using FTP.

dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · dsh-plugin-ftp-server：Run a **configurable FTP file server** inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), managed from a browser settings panel. Host any directory over plain FTP — browse, upload, download, rename and delete files with any FTP client.

> ⚠️ Plain FTP has no TLS: credentials and data travel in cleartext. Use it on trusted networks only.

dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · Features：- Zero-dependency FTP server core (pure Node built-ins), spawned as a child process of the harness
- Full command support: `USER/PASS`, `PWD/CWD/CDUP`, `LIST/NLST/MLSD`, `RETR/STOR/APPE/STOU`, `DELE/MKD/RMD`, `RNFR/RNTO`, `SIZE/MDTM/REST` (resume), `PASV/EPSV/PORT`, `FEAT/STAT/ABOR/NOOP`
- Chrooted to the shared root — path escape (`..`) is blocked, and the root itself cannot be deleted or renamed
- Single account + password, or anonymous mode
- Browser panel (Settings → FTP 服务): configure host/port/root/credentials, start/stop, live status (PID, uptime), shared-root listing and server log
- Idle timeout (180 s), crash detection, automatic child-process cleanup when the plugin is stopped

dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YinjiangCN/dsh-plugin-ftp-server
```

Then **restart dsh**. Open **Settings → FTP 服务**, fill in the form and click **启动服务**.

dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · Usage：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 监听地址 (host) | `0.0.0.0` | Bind address |
| 端口 (port) | `2121` | Control port |
| 共享根目录 (root) | `workspace/ftp-root` | Directory shared over FTP (created on start) |
| 用户名 (user) | `ftp` | Login account (ignored in anonymous mode) |
| 密码 (pass) | *(empty)* | Login password |
| 允许匿名 (anonymous) | off | Allow anonymous login |
dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · Usage：Clients connect with `ftp://<user>@<host>:<port>`. The password is kept in memory only; it is passed as a child-process argument and never written to disk.

dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · Security notes：- **Do not set 共享根目录 to `/`** unless you really want to share the whole filesystem — anyone with the credentials can read/modify every file (the server runs with the harness user's privileges).
- Plain FTP is unencrypted; prefer an internal/trusted network.
- The server supports one account; for multiple users run multiple instances on different ports.

dsh-plugin-ftp-server README · Development：```
lib/index.js      host half — FTP process management + Typert Remote service `ftpServer`
lib/client.js     browser half — settings panel (module-loader bundle)
lib/ftp-server.js standalone FTP server (spawned by the host half)
cordis.patch.yml  loader patch mounting the host half

The host half registers the `ftpServer` Remote service; the panel calls `status/start/stop/listRoot` through the Typert Gateway (host-side SRC-mode discovery with hand-written strict client descriptors).
